description:
Cha-Ching gives indie founders and small software businesses one focused place to connect the payment accounts they already use.

Sign in with Apple, authorize Stripe and PayPal through provider-hosted pages, and manage each connection without pasting credentials into the app.

MVP features:
• Secure Sign in with Apple
• Connect one Stripe account
• Connect one PayPal account
• View current connection status
• Disconnect provider access whenever you choose

Provider access tokens are encrypted before storage and are never persisted on your iPhone. Cha-Ching is not accounting, banking, payout, or financial-advice software.

Verified sale ingestion and payment notifications will only be advertised as live after those features complete production verification.
promotionalText: Securely connect Stripe and PayPal, then keep each provider connection visible and under your control.
